title: Competition and Consumer Act 2016 (Act No. 10 of 2016)
citation: Competition and Consumer Act 2016, Act No. 10 of 2016
evidence: Commencement date stated on page 5 of the official Act published by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (mcil.gov.ws/node/37): '[Assent date: 9 February 2016]', '[Commencement date: 3July 2017]'. Opened 2026-11-05.
notes: Part 5 Division 1 covers misleading or deceptive conduct generally (section 55) and in relation to goods, services and employment (section 56); section 63 covers misleading representations about certain businesses. Administered by the Competition and Consumer Commission within the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour. Acts as the statutory umbrella for environmental and green claims. English is the official language of legislation; no official Samoan text was served by MCIL. One record stored for the adopted Act effective 2017-07-03 under WS-MCIL-ADOPTED (statute pass on Samoa Copyright Act 1998 s. 5(b)).

title: Planning and Urban Management Act 2004 (Act No. 5 of 2004)
citation: Planning and Urban Management Act 2004, Act No. 5 of 2004
evidence: Commencement date stated on page 4 of the official Act published by the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (mnre.gov.ws): '[Assent date: 21 January 2004]', '[Commencement Date: 1 July 2004]'. Opened 2026-11-05.
notes: Establishes the Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA) within MNRE and provides the statutory framework for sustainable management plans (Part IV), development consents and environmental impact assessment (Part V) for land use and environmental protection. One of Samoa's environmental framework acts alongside the Lands, Surveys and Environment Act 1989. English is the official language of legislation; no official Samoan text was served by MNRE. One record stored for the adopted Act effective 2004-07-01 under WS-MNRE-ADOPTED (statute pass on Samoa Copyright Act 1998 s. 5(b)).

title: Lands, Surveys and Environment Act 1989 (Act No. 33 of 1989)
citation: Lands, Surveys and Environment Act 1989, Act No. 33 of 1989
evidence: Commencement date stated on page 3 of the official Act published by the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (mnre.gov.ws): '(5 March 1990)'. Opened 2026-11-05.
notes: Principal statutory framework for conservation and protection of the environment (Part VIII), pollution control, coastal zones, and national parks and reserves. Administered by MNRE. Amended in 2004 by the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004 (s. 106) and in 2026 by the Lands, Surveys and Environment Amendment Act 2026. English is the official language of legislation; no official Samoan text was served by MNRE. One record stored for the adopted Act effective 1990-03-05 under WS-MNRE-ADOPTED (statute pass on Samoa Copyright Act 1998 s. 5(b)).
